# ekv v0.4.0 - Table of Contents

Eventually consistent durable KV store for Elixir with zero runtime dependencies.
Data survives node restarts, node death, and network partitions.
Direct member replication across Erlang nodes with delta sync.

## Modules

- [EKV](https://ekv.hexdocs.pm/EKV.md): Eventually consistent durable KV store with opt-in per-key linearizable CAS.
- [EKV.Event](https://ekv.hexdocs.pm/EKV.Event.md): Represents a key change event delivered to subscribers.
